references.text: Both texts concern God's creation, especially the creation of man on earth
Refers to God's creation of man (adam) on earth
Describes how God created man (adam) from the dust of the ground
Mentions the ends of heaven and the extent of the earth, similar to the expression 'from one end of heaven to the other'
The heavens declare God's greatness to the ends of the earth
Calls for understanding from the beginning and the founding of the earth
Refers to God who has worked from the beginning
Challenges the peoples to testify about former things that have happened
Asks if anything similar has happened in former days
Refers to creation and that nothing like it has occurred since God created the world
